name: Coolify
statusNote: Initial provider implementation. Test against the target Coolify version and API permissions before production use.
description: Deploy Shipper applications and multi-service stacks to self-hosted or cloud Coolify instances.
features: Git, Docker Image, and Dockerfile Deployment
install:
composer config repositories.provider-coolify git https://github.com/shippercli/provider-coolify.git
composer require 'shippercli/cli:^1.0.5' 'shippercli/provider-coolify:^1.0'
